description: This file contains a stock analytics report implementation for ERPNext, including functions for generating report columns, processing stock ledger data, and creating chart data.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate stock analytics report data, including columns, data, and chart.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the stock analytics report based on filters.

methods.name: get_period_date_ranges
methods.description: Calculates date ranges for report periods based on the selected range type.

methods.name: round_down_to_nearest_frequency
methods.description: Rounds a date down to the start of the period based on frequency (monthly, quarterly, yearly, weekly).

methods.name: get_period
methods.description: Returns a string label for a period (week, month, quarter, year) based on a date and filters.

methods.name: get_periodic_data
methods.description: Processes stock ledger entries to compute periodic balances and values per item and warehouse.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches item details, stock ledger entries, and processes data for report rows.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Generates chart configuration data based on report columns.
